title: Concept: TLS checks disabled (k8s) — review required
description: For k8s, insecure-skip-tls-verifys*:s*true turns authenticity checks off. Automation carries sensitive credentials, so its TLS must be strictest. The remedy is valid cluster certificates.
applicability: Scripts and manifests invoking k8s; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Credential interception on automation paths; HIGH severity.
